item.name: particle-field
item.summary: background: WebGL2 vertex-shader particle drift with pointer repel (webgl2, client-only, ~4 KB, reduced motion -> poster, mobile -> tier 2 / tier 1 poster)

useWhen: Hero sections requiring discrete starry or kinetic depth points
Telemetry or scientific landing pages needing particle drift and fine pointer interaction
Surfaces seeking subtle stellar motion with constant GPU cost
avoidWhen: Dense text sections without an active contrast scrim
Pages already running a continuous full-screen shader
Low-power mobile devices where the static dot pattern is preferred

alternatives.name: noise-field
alternatives.when: When continuous organic liquid waves are preferred over discrete points

alternatives.name: mesh-gradient
alternatives.when: When soft blurred color transitions are preferred

tiers.0: Static CSS dot pattern poster matching particle color
tiers.1: Static CSS dot pattern poster for low-end hardware
tiers.2: WebGL2 rendered at DPR <= 1.5 with ~35% particle density and no touch listeners
tiers.3: Full WebGL2 rendered at DPR <= 2.0 with up to 4,000 particles and fine pointer repulsion

reducedMotion.description: Renders static CSS dot pattern poster with zero WebGL allocation and zero rAF loops.

input.pointer: Fine pointer repulsion within 140px interaction radius
input.touch: Zero pointer listeners on touch devices; automatic fallback to Tier 1 poster or Tier 2 drift
input.keyboard: None; container is non-interactive aria-hidden decorative surface

a11y.notes: Canvas element is marked aria-hidden='true'. Particle twinkle frequency is strictly capped below 3 Hz (WCAG 2.3.1).

props.name: color
props.effect: Particle color, resolved dynamically from CSS variables or theme tokens.

props.name: count
props.effect: Target particle count on Tier 3 (clamped to max 4,000; scaled down on Tier 2).

props.name: interactive
props.effect: Enables fine-pointer repulsion on desktop fine pointers.

props.name: scrim
props.effect: Renders an accessible contrast gradient overlay for legibility of child text.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Explicitly freezes the particle simulation loop.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Upper bound cap on the resolved capability tier.

props.name: reducedMotion
props.effect: Manual override forcing static poster fallback.

mistakes: Do not attach window mouse listeners; ParticleField handles fine pointer repulsion internally and suppresses listeners on coarse touch pointers.
Do not combine multiple ParticleField instances in the same viewport.
Never call requestAnimationFrame directly to animate particles.
verify: Confirm static CSS dot pattern poster renders in server HTML with zero CLS.
Confirm that when prefers-reduced-motion is active, static poster renders with zero WebGL contexts allocated and zero rAF cycles.
Confirm context lease is released when scrolled out of view.
